reviews.title: Oced to 7180 Cl 32 42 42 40 88
reviews.comment:
Solid die with hood over locking options. 
I have a hero z890 I put xmp extreme let it boot and find ideal timings. Then I lower from 44 to 42 and 88 respectively) and restart. Then manual select the speed(leave xmp tweaked alone it helps with the difficult secondary timings) and bring CL to 32. Let it's reboot. Load into windows. Then reboot again check CPU z and run stability.

reviews.title: Speed Without the Bulk
reviews.comment: Building a high-end PC in 2026 often means chasing top speeds, and the Corsair Vengeance RGB 7200MHz kit is among the best options available. While 6000MHz is the standard choice, the 7200MHz C34 kit is ideal for maximizing performance with Intel's 14th or 15th Gen processors. It's fast, visually appealing, and fits under most CPU coolers, unlike the bulkier "Dominator" models.ing it a significant improvement over the bulkier "Dominator" modules.
